command: set -Eeuo pipefail; test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77; SRC=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_daemon.py; MIR=$HOME/.local/share/clay-local-bridge/control-mirror; BR=chatgpt-local-ai-core-node-control; T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; ORIGIN=$(git -C "$MIR" remote get-url origin); git clone -q --no-hardlinks "$MIR" "$T/r"; git -C "$T/r" remote set-url origin "$ORIGIN"; git -C "$T/r" fetch -q origin "$BR"; git -C "$T/r" checkout -q -B "$BR" "origin/$BR"; cp "$SRC" "$T/r/local_bridge/daemon.py"; echo RUNTIME_SHA=$(sha256sum "$SRC"|cut -d' ' -f1); echo REPO_BEFORE=$(git -C "$MIR" show "origin/$BR:local_bridge/daemon.py" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); echo '=== DIFFSTAT ==='; git -C "$T/r" diff --stat; git -C "$T/r" diff --check; if git -C "$T/r" diff --quiet; then echo NO_CHANGE; exit 0; fi; git -C "$T/r" config user.name 'FranKenstein bridge convergence'; git -C "$T/r" config user.email 'bridge@localhost'; git -C "$T/r" add local_bridge/daemon.py; git -C "$T/r" commit -qm 'local bridge: persist verified machine-bound routing'; git -C "$T/r" fetch -q origin "$BR"; git -C "$T/r" rebase -q "origin/$BR"; git -C "$T/r" push -q origin "HEAD:$BR"; echo PUSHED=$(git -C "$T/r" rev-parse HEAD)
